rules: Business state and transport state are shown as two separate lines, never merged into one badge.
Every state has an icon AND words. Color is never the only signal.
Approved never looks like sent. Sent never looks like delivered.
A pending marker (anything not terminal and not delivered) is shown on the card and in the Outbox tab badge, and is restored after a restart.
Approve is only offered in business state 'proposed'. Every other state offers at most revoke, view evidence or ask someone.
The SIMULATED label is shown on every card whose recipient.channel is 'simulated'.

offline.label: screen.offline
offline.where: banner on every screen; the app keeps working

empty.where: Today when no feedback is saved

working.label: screen.working
working.where: card placeholder while the local model runs; offers cancel
